# Payroll anomaly detector - model documentation (generated by the workflow notebook)

## 1. Business problem
Flag risky payslips before payout, rank them for clerks, explain each flag, estimate money at risk (proxy). Assumptions: {'review_minutes_per_flag': 6, 'review_cost_per_minute_inr': 5, 'working_days_per_month': 22}.

## 2. Target and timing
Binary: payslip error (1) vs normal (0). Unit: one payslip. Predicted after the run is calculated, before payout. Training is unsupervised; labels (CX-06) are evaluation-only.

## 3. Data
payroll_monthly_features.csv - 7355 rows, 18 monthly runs (2025-04 to 2026-09); synthetic. SHA-256 prefix c7031da77ccaa5ab. Dictionary: workflow38/payroll_data_dictionary.csv.

## 4. Data quality and cleaning
{'duplicate employee+run pairs': 15, 'negative net pay': 8, 'zero net pay': 5, 'gross - deductions != net': 42, 'gross != expected gross': 35, 'overtime hours above 50': 8, 'components do not add to total deductions': 5, 'extreme net pay (|z| > 5 on log scale)': 15, 'variable_pay_type missing': 6202, 'target label quality': 0}. Nothing was deleted; anomalous rows are the signal. Decisions: workflow38/payroll_cleaning_decisions.csv.

## 5. Features and preprocessing
23 numeric features (ratios, identity gaps, amounts); median imputation with indicators, standard scaling, Isolation Forest (300 trees, contamination 0.03, seed 42); fitted on training rows only.

## 6. Split
Temporal: train 2025-04..2026-03, validation 2026-04..06, test 2026-07..09. Development errors were injected synthetically (NOT CX-06).

## 9. Threshold and calibration
{'score_threshold': 0.8, 'chosen_on': 'validation only', 'rule': 'minimise cost subject to real flag share <= 5.0%', 'production_operating_point': 'rules OR forest outlier (contamination 3%)', 'production_real_flag_share_%': 5.68}. Calibration: scores are rankings, no calibrator (Brier: {'raw score used as probability': 0.0821, 'Platt scaling': 0.0201, 'isotonic regression': 0.0228, 'constant prevalence': 0.0321}).

## 10. Limitations, risks, fairness
Synthetic data; precision depends on prevalence; flags are review candidates; money_at_risk is a proxy; fairness screen: {'groups_over_2x': 3, 'overall_flag_rate': 0.0568}; known weak spot: {'INFLATED_VARIABLE': 2}.

## 11. Deployment and monitoring
FastAPI service loads the model once; monitoring via monthly PSI/flag-rate table (alerts: ['2025-04', '2025-10', '2026-02', '2026-04']); rollback via model_registry.json.

## 12. Reproduce
`python scripts/train_phase2_models.py`, then run the notebooks in order; tests: `python tests_phase2/run_all.py`. Tests in this notebook: {'PASS': 25, 'SKIPPED': 1}.
